title: Advancing AI with Integrity: Ethical Challenges and Solutions in Neural Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of representational disparities and data scarcity in low-resource languages (e.g., Luganda) compared to high-resource languages, assessing the effectiveness of mitigation strategies such as data augmentation, ensemble learning, and Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization.

Qualitative assessment of the loss of cultural context and semantics in Neural Machine Translation (NMT) outputs, evaluating the necessity of culturally proficient human post-editing and community stakeholder involvement to preserve cultural representation.

Reviewing the introduction of inductive social biases and offensive/discriminatory language in translation datasets and human annotations, evaluating mitigation approaches like contrastive learning debiasing, data filtering, and using diverse human reviewers.
